notes.text:
This update for poppler fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-11896: infinite recursion leading to stack overflow due to object loop in PDF CMap (bsc#1252337).

notes.text: In Xpdf 4.05 (and earlier), a PDF object loop in a CMap, via the "UseCMap" entry, leads to infinite recursion and a stack overflow.
notes.title: CVE description

remediations.details: To install this SUSE Security Update use the SUSE recommended installation methods like YaST online_update or "zypper patch".
